user_story: As a user, I want to interact with JavaScript alert dialogs on the page so that I can see how alerts, confirms, and prompts work. Acceptance Criteria: When I click the button with text 'Click for JS Alert', a JavaScript alert should appear. The page should remain the same, and I should be able to dismiss the alert. Additionally, if I click the button with text 'Click for JS Confirm', the behavior should be similar, and I should not see any unexpected error messages.
